personality_one_liner: Une expérience sombre, cinématographique et luxueuse, mettant en valeur l'art de la production avec des jeux d'ombre, de verre et des accents dorés.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for cinematic feel. Avoid dense clustering. Use md/lg for internal card padding and xl/2xl for section spacing.

do's: Use heavily on sticky headers and bottom tab bar.
Use for featured service cards overlapping the hero background.
Use as a backdrop for modal sheets and the quote form fields.
Always include a translucent tint base (>= 75% opacity of surface) under the blur to ensure contrast.
dont's: Don't stack more than two glass surfaces.
Don't use pure white for glass tints; use surfaceInverse or surface to match the dark theme.

screens.name: Accueil (Home)
screens.purpose: Accueillir l'utilisateur avec une vidéo/image plein écran et présenter l'univers de Big S Media Production.

states.loading: Logo doré pulsant sur fond noir.
states.error: Message élégant d'erreur de chargement avec bouton 'Réessayer' bordé d'or.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image behind the entire screen. A vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surface at bottom) over the image. A massive Cormorant Garamond title at the bottom half, followed by a primary glassmorphic 'Demander un devis' button.

screens.name: Services
screens.purpose: Détailler les offres (Production Audiovisuelle et Numérisation de Cassettes).
screens.layout: Sticky glass header with segmented control (Production / Numérisation). A vertical list of large cards with background imagery and gradient scrims. Text anchored at the bottom of each card. CTA on each card to book/request.

screens.name: Portfolio

states.empty: Aucun projet publié pour le moment.
states.error: Échec du chargement de la galerie.

screens.layout: Masonry grid or full-width immersive list of high-quality project stills. Minimal text, let the imagery breathe. Tapping an image opens a full-screen glass modal with project details.

screens.name: Devis & Contact
screens.purpose: Formulaire de contact et de réservation multi-étapes.
screens.layout: Step-by-step form with glassmorphic input fields resting on surfaceSecondary. Large thumb-friendly targets. Bottom sticky primary CTA 'Continuer' with safe-area padding.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Espace gestion pour suivre les demandes et projets.

states.empty: Aucune demande en attente, illustration minimaliste d'un bureau.

screens.layout: Utility-first layout tailored for admin. Segmented controls for Requests / Appointments / Projects. List items with clear status badges (using success/warning tokens). Drawer or secondary sheet for item details.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '6 Glass / Luxe DARK' personality rigorously: cinematic deep blacks (#050505), high contrast white text, and metallic/gold accents (#C9A84C).
Utilize Cormorant Garamond for all headings to establish a luxurious, editorial feel, and Geist for UI body text.
Implement a mandatory vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surface inverse/black) on any image with text overlay to guarantee WCAG contrast.
The UI is entirely in French (Accueil, Services, Devis, Portfolio).
Admin Dashboard should be accessible via a hidden gesture or a subtle link in settings, offering a list view of form submissions.
Ensure glassmorphism is used on floating/sticky elements (headers, tab bars) with a proper underlying tint (>=75% opacity) so the text remains legible over scrolling backgrounds.
